enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Wild Frenzy +122: This weapon has a tendency to drive those it strikes insane. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit the target will go wild and attack its own allies for 15 seconds if it fails a DC 122 Will save. Enemies driven wild in this way, however, have a chance of coming to their senses if damaged.

Revel in Blood (Slashing): Your weapon hungers to let blood flow. Your attacks and offensive spells have a high chance to deal very strong Bane damage over time to creatures vulnerable to Bleeding. On weapon crit: 16d6 Slashing Damage.
Unbalancing: Anything that melee attacks a character with an Unbalancing item has a chance to be pulled off balance giving them a -2 penalty to their AC.
Unwieldy: This weapon is very large and makes you clumsier as you wield it, causing a -2 Dexterity penalty.
